response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong backend and distributed-systems engineering expertise and is actively contributing to agentic-AI infrastructure at re:cinq. However, this CTO role requires proven executive leadership (scaling teams, P&L responsibility), production multi-agent AI system architecture at an ownership level, and fintech domain expertise—none of which are evident on the resume. His recent entry into AI-agent systems (~16 months) is too nascent for a role demanding deep production experience and strategic technical vision.
strengths: Deep backend/distributed systems expertise from high-scale environments (millions of RPS at Dunnhumby) with strong event-driven architecture fundamentals
Currently embedded in agentic AI infrastructure work at re:cinq with hands-on exposure to frameworks and workflows
Proven engineering excellence through testing advocacy, TDD practices, and technical mentorship across multiple organizations
concerns: No demonstrated executive leadership experience or track record managing and scaling engineering teams; all roles are individual contributor level
Production multi-agent AI experience is very recent (~16 months) and described as contributing to infrastructure rather than architecting systems
Zero fintech or regulated financial services domain experience; no evidence of operating systems with financial or regulatory consequences
